# ShinyCellModular: Developer Guide

This guide is for anyone extending ShinyCellModular: adding a tab, modifying
an existing one, or adding a new data type.

## Start here: adding a new tab

1. Scaffold the file:

```r
templateShinyCellModular(
  id      = "my_new_tab",
  title   = "My New Tab",
  author  = "Your Name",
  contact = "your.email@monash.edu"
)
```

2. Fill in the `_ui` and `_server` function bodies in the generated file.
3. Test it in isolation:

```r
useShinyCellModular(data_type = "RNA", enabled_tabs = "my_new_tab", out_dir = "testing_data/")
```

That's the whole loop. See [Adding a new tab](developer_guide_new_tab.html)
for the full walkthrough, including the module shape and the server
arguments available to you.
